items.title: Comparison of depth and of the depth-dimension sum between a local ring and its ideal-adic completion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement compares the depth of a finite module at a prime of a Noetherian ring having a dualizing complex with the depth of its completion at a prime lying over it, proving an inequality and an equality for the sum of the depth and the dimension of the quotient (author lemma at source lines 2562-2582, label lemma-change-completion). The proof (source lines 2584-2621) uses the flatness of the completion to split off the formal fibre, the Cohen-Macaulay property of the formal fibres to replace the depth of that fibre by its dimension, and the catenary property together with the equality of the ideal-adic completions of the two dimension quotients to identify the resulting expression with the original one (proof lines 2603-2620). The chain of rewritings of the depth-dimension sum is the content. H2.
